message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are generally handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** (APD), which serves as the primary agency for enforcing the city’s noise ordinances. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | Details | |--------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website:
• Navigate to “City Services” → “Police” → “Report a Crime” (or use the “Report a Problem” portal).
• Select “Noise Complaint” from the list of available reports.
• Fill out the required information (location, time, description, etc.) and submit. | | **Phone** | • Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line: **(404) 656‑4000**.
• Tell the dispatcher you’d like to file a noise complaint and provide the necessary details. | | **In‑person** | • Visit the nearest APD precinct office.
• Speak with a patrol officer or administrative staff and fill out a noise‑complaint form. | | **Mobile App** | • Download the “Atlanta Police Department” app (available on iOS and Android).
• Use the “Report a Crime” feature and select “Noise.” | ### What Information Is Needed? When filing a noise complaint, you’ll typically need: 1. **Location** – Exact address or intersection. 2. **Time & Date** – When the noise started and how long it lasted. 3. **Description** – Type of noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 4. **Frequency** – Whether it’s a one‑time event or recurring. 5. **Any Witnesses** – Names or contact info if available. Providing as much detail as possible helps the police investigate more efficiently. ### Follow‑up After filing, the APD will assign a case number. You can track the status of your complaint by: - Calling the non‑emergency line and asking for the case number. - Checking the City of Atlanta’s online portal (if you submitted online). - Visiting the precinct office where you filed the complaint. If the noise violates the city’s noise ordinance (typically defined as sound levels above 70 dB during daytime hours or 60 dB at night), the police may issue a citation or take other enforcement action. --- **Quick Contact Info** - **Atlanta Police Department Non‑Emergency Line:** (404) 656‑4000 - **City of Atlanta Official Website:** - **APD Online Reporting Portal:** (direct link may vary) Feel free to let me know if you need help navigating the online portal or have any other questions!
